purpose: Exploratory target-course retrieval benchmark, not a student preference study.
authorship: Cases and target labels constructed with Codex assistance from the frozen catalog before executing any comparison.
labelDefinition: One designated target per intent; other returned courses may also be relevant. Not exhaustive relevance judgments.
sampling: Two purposively selected target courses per program, paired literal and natural-language queries; 26 intents, 52 correlated query cases. Not representative random sampling.
developmentSeparation: Exact evaluation queries are different from previous functional smoke queries. Cases are not an independent human-rated holdout. No model or parameter tuning will use their results.

cases.query: human physiological systems
cases.targetBasis: In this course engineering analyses are applied to cellular systems, the electrical and mechanical activity of the heart, the structure and function of the respiratory, nervous and cardiovascular systems, and basic reaction kinetics, pharmacokinetic modeling and tracer kinetics. In the laboratory, students design systems for measurement of human physiological parameters.
